blocks.text: “A Perfect Marriage,” the drama film starring Kim Chiu and Paulo Avelino completes the Metro Manila Film Festival’s (MMFF) “Magic 8,” or its official lineup that would compete in its 52nd edition. The second batch of movie entries was unveiled during ceremonies held on Monday at the Shangrila Plaza Mall in Mandaluyong, hosted by Kaladkaren and Enchong Dee. Aside from “A Perfect Marriage,” the three other finalists are: “Los Salvajes Bravos,” starring Ruru Madrid and Romnick Sarmenta; “LIttle Hope,” starring Yassi Pressman and Pepe Herrera; and “Seeds of Peace,” starring Zaijian Jaranilla.
